feed.title: 一孔录 · Reading the classics word by word
feed.subtitle: Every line Yikonglu has read aloud can be checked here.

entry.title: 4.4 Set your heart on humaneness and there is no evil
entry.summary: 子曰：苟志于仁矣，无恶也。 —— Resolve does not guarantee no mistakes; it guarantees no intention to do wrong. Today: a learner driver scrapes the car three times in a year but never once runs a red light.

entry.title: 4.3 Only the humane can love and hate others
entry.summary: 子曰：唯仁者能好人，能恶人。 —— Everyone can like and dislike; the “can” lies in doing it rightly, which requires a heart that is not tied to anything. Today: a competition judge who sees a former student take the stage stands up, leaves the panel and gives no score for that round.

entry.title: 4.2 The inhumane cannot long endure hardship
entry.summary: 子曰：不仁者不可以久处约，不可以长处乐。仁者安仁，知者利仁。 —— Long hardship makes people overstep, long pleasure makes them indulge; whether outside things can take a person away depends on whether the original heart is there. Today: someone out of work for six months still gets up at seven, shaves, and goes out for a run.

entry.title: 4.1 Living among the humane is beautiful
entry.summary: 子曰：里仁为美。择不处仁，焉得知？ —— Choose the wrong place to live and what you lose is not the house but the heart that tells right from wrong. Today: when buying a flat people ask about schools, the metro and sunlight, and rarely about how the neighbours treat one another.

entry.title: 3.26 High position without generosity
entry.summary: 子曰：居上不宽，为礼不敬，临丧不哀，吾何以观之哉？ —— It is not that it looks bad; there is nothing left to look at. Today: the man on the phone talking business at the door of the funeral hall — however large his gift, no one remembers he came.

entry.title: 3.25 The Shao is perfectly beautiful and perfectly good
entry.summary: 子谓韶：尽美矣，又尽善也。谓武：尽美矣，未尽善也。 —— The difference is in how it came: one was yielded, one was taken by force. Today: two equally splendid wins, one earned head-on, one after the opponent withdrew injured — the podium does not taste the same.

entry.title: 3.24 The border warden of Yi asks to see him
entry.summary: 仪封人请见，曰：君子之至于斯也，吾未尝不得见也。从者见之。出曰：二三子何患于丧乎？天下之无道也久矣，天将以夫子为木铎。 —— A minor official saw Confucius's weight at first sight. Today: an old teacher moved off the podium runs free classes in the community, and more people come than were ever in his class.

entry.title: 3.23 The Master speaks of music to the Grand Music Master of Lu
entry.summary: 子语鲁大师乐，曰：乐其可知也：始作，翕如也；从之，纯如也，皦如也，绎如也，以成。 —— First together, then harmonious, each part clear within the harmony, linked to the end. Today: a choir starts together, then blends, each voice part still audible, singing through in one breath.

entry.title: 3.22 Guan Zhong's capacity was small
entry.summary: 子曰：管仲之器小哉！或曰：管仲俭乎？曰：管氏有三归，官事不摄，焉得俭？然则管仲知礼乎？曰：邦君树塞门，管氏亦树塞门；邦君为两君之好，有反坫，管氏亦有反坫。管氏而知礼，孰不知礼？ —— Confucius does not say outright where the smallness lies; it shows in the luxury and usurpation. Today: the company grows, the boss's office becomes a palace, and the rules apply only to others.

entry.title: 3.21 Duke Ai asks about the altar of the soil
entry.summary: 哀公问社于宰我。宰我对曰：夏后氏以松，殷人以柏，周人以栗，曰：使民战栗。子闻之，曰：成事不说，遂事不谏，既往不咎。 —— The three “nots” are not “never mind” but a heavy rebuke, to make him careful in future. Today: forwarding an unverified message in a group chat — the recall button only works for two minutes.

entry.title: 3.20 The Guanju: joy without excess
entry.summary: 子曰：关雎乐而不淫，哀而不伤。 —— Not too little feeling, but feeling full without going over. Today: crying while reading your wedding vows, wiping your eyes and finishing the last line.

entry.title: 3.19 The lord employs his ministers with ritual
entry.summary: 定公问：君使臣，臣事君，如之何？孔子对曰：君使臣以礼，臣事君以忠。 —— Each side looks only at its own end; Duke Ding was the ruler, and his question was answered with his own half. Today: a team lead first asks whether people are treated with enough respect; the team member first asks whether the work is done properly.

entry.title: 3.18 Serving one's lord with full ritual
entry.summary: 子曰：事君尽礼，人以为谄也。 —— Not a bit extra — ritual simply requires this; Confucius says only “people take it for flattery”, with no insult back. Today: getting to the meeting early and filling in expense forms fully, and being mocked as a try-hard.

entry.title: 3.17 The sheep for announcing the new moon
entry.summary: 子贡欲去告朔之饩羊。子曰：赐也，尔爱其羊，我爱其礼。 —— The sheep marks the rite; keep the marker and the rite can still be recognised and restored. Today: an old shop that makes one pot of the old recipe at the winter solstice, not for sale.

entry.title: 3.16 In archery, piercing the hide is not the point
entry.summary: 子曰：射不主皮，为力不同科，古之道也。 —— The contest is in what can be trained, not in what you were born with.

entry.title: 3.15 In the Grand Temple he asked about everything
entry.summary: 子入大庙，每事问。或曰：孰谓鄹人之子知礼乎？入大庙，每事问。子闻之，曰：是礼也。 —— Thirty years in, you still double-check.

entry.title: 3.14 Zhou looked to the two dynasties
entry.summary: 子曰：周监于二代，郁郁乎文哉！吾从周。 —— Following Zhou means following the work of improving on predecessors bit by bit. Today: the dishes at New Year's Eve dinner.

entry.title: 3.13 Better to court the stove
entry.summary: 王孙贾问曰：与其媚于奥，宁媚于灶，何谓也？子曰：不然。获罪于天，无所祷也。 —— Do the thing right and everyone is easy to deal with; do it wrong and being on good terms with anyone won't help.

entry.title: 3.12 Sacrifice as if present
entry.summary: 祭如在，祭神如神在。子曰：吾不与祭，如不祭。 —— The form of the rite can be laid out by the book; the heart in it has to be brought by the one who sacrifices.

entry.title: 3.11 Someone asks about the di sacrifice
entry.summary: 或问禘之说。子曰：不知也。知其说者之于天下也，其如示诸斯乎！指其掌。 —— Saying “I don't know” does not mean he didn't know.

entry.title: 3.10 The di sacrifice after the libation
entry.summary: 子曰：禘自既灌而往者，吾不欲观之矣。 —— Looking back, the records and the people are gone; looking around, the rite is there but the heart is not.

entry.title: 3.9 Not enough records
entry.summary: 子曰：夏礼吾能言之，杞不足征也；殷礼吾能言之，宋不足征也。文献不足故也。足，则吾能征之矣。 —— Confucius could tell it, but would not rest on his word alone. Today: grandmother's recipe — what's missing is the person standing at the stove.

entry.title: 3.8 The painting comes after the white ground
entry.summary: 子夏问曰：巧笑倩兮，美目盼兮，素以为绚兮。何谓也？子曰：绘事后素。曰：礼后乎？子曰：起予者商也！始可与言诗已矣。 —— If the ground is not smooth, every colour you put on comes out blotchy.

entry.title: 3.7 The gentleman does not compete
entry.summary: 子曰：君子无所争，必也射乎！揖让而升，下而饮。其争也君子。 —— The target does not lie; what is contested is whether your own hand is steady.

entry.title: 3.6 The Ji sacrifice to Mount Tai
entry.summary: 季氏旅于泰山。子谓冉有曰：女弗能救与？对曰：不能。子曰：呜呼！曾谓泰山不如林放乎？ —— It was the Ji who needed saving, not Mount Tai. Today: working for a boss you cannot talk out of it.

entry.title: 3.5 The Yi and Di have rulers
entry.summary: 子曰：夷狄之有君，不如诸夏之亡也。 —— The rebuke is aimed not at the Yi and Di but at his own people. Today: an old family firm where each branch keeps its own books.

entry.title: 3.4 Lin Fang asks about the root of ritual
entry.summary: 林放问礼之本。子曰：大哉问！礼，与其奢也，宁俭；丧，与其易也，宁戚。 —— When both sides are off, lean towards the root. Today: a table full of dishes vs. a bowl of noodles.

entry.title: 3.3 A person without humaneness — what of ritual?
entry.summary: 子曰：人而不仁，如礼何？人而不仁，如乐何？ —— Fill the eight rows, sing the emperor's ode — if the person is wrong, ritual and music can do nothing with him.

entry.title: 3.2 The three families clear away to the Yong
entry.summary: 三家者以雍彻。子曰：相维辟公，天子穆穆，奚取于三家之堂？ —— They didn't even understand the song they sang. Today: a corner shop's banner “Welcoming heads of state”.

entry.title: 3.1 Eight rows of dancers in his courtyard
entry.summary: 孔子谓季氏：八佾舞于庭，是可忍也，孰不可忍也！ —— Four extra rows of dancers measure how hard a heart has become. Today: sitting in the boss's chair at the meeting.

entry.title: 2.24 Sacrificing to spirits not one's own
entry.summary: 子曰：非其鬼而祭之，谄也。见义不为，无勇也。 —— Taking gifts to the home of a boss you have nothing to do with; saying nothing in the meeting.

entry.title: 2.23 Can ten generations be known?
entry.summary: 子张问：十世可知也？子曰：殷因于夏礼，所损益，可知也；周因于殷礼，所损益，可知也。其或继周者，虽百世，可知也。 —— He watched two handovers and saw what stayed and what changed.

entry.title: 2.22 A person without trustworthiness
entry.summary: 子曰：人而无信，不知其可也。大车无輗，小车无軏，其何以行之哉？ —— Without it, the ox is an ox and the cart is a cart; they never connect.

entry.title: 2.21 Why do you not take part in government?
entry.summary: 或谓孔子曰：子奚不为政？子曰：书云：孝乎！惟孝友于兄弟，施於有政。是亦为政，奚其为为政？ —— The words are a pretext, and the point is also true.

entry.title: 2.20 Approach them with dignity
entry.summary: 季康子问：使民敬、忠以劝，如之何？子曰：临之以庄则敬，孝慈则忠，举善而教不能则劝。 —— Ji Kangzi asks for a method; Confucius answers with duty. Treating duty as a method goes wrong again.

entry.title: 2.19 Raise up the straight
entry.summary: 哀公问曰：何为则民服？孔子对曰：举直错诸枉，则民服；举枉错诸直，则民不服。 —— The hard part is seeing who is straight. Today: promoting the people who only bring good news.

entry.title: 2.18 Zizhang studies to gain office
entry.summary: 子张学干禄。子曰：多闻阙疑，慎言其余，则寡尤；多见阙殆，慎行其余，则寡悔。言寡尤，行寡悔，禄在其中矣。 —— Confucius promises nothing; he turns seeking office into a lesson in being a person.

entry.title: 2.17 To know what you know
entry.summary: 子曰：由！诲女知之乎？知之为知之，不知为不知，是知也。 —— Admitting you do not know is where it starts.

entry.title: 2.16 Working at strange doctrines
entry.summary: 子曰：攻乎异端，斯害也已。 —— Following Zhu Xi: burrowing into it is what does harm.

entry.title: 2.15 Learning without thinking
entry.summary: 子曰：学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆。 —— One is empty, the other hangs in the air. Today: bookmarking online courses without thinking vs. building theories without reading.

entry.title: 2.14 Inclusive, not partisan
entry.summary: 子曰：君子周而不比，小人比而不周。 —— Same dishes on the table, different reasons for the dinner.

entry.title: 2.13 Act first, then speak
entry.summary: 子贡问君子。子曰：先行其言，而后从之。 —— You still speak — only afterwards.

entry.title: 2.12 The gentleman is not a vessel
entry.summary: 子曰：君子不器。 —— Virtue made whole first, then it can be used anywhere — not learning a hundred trades. Today: the accountant everyone likes to ask for advice.

entry.title: 2.11 Reviewing the old to know the new
entry.summary: 子曰：温故而知新，可以为师矣。 —— If you can only recite it, reheating it a hundred times still gives the same bowl.

entry.title: 2.10 Look at what he does
entry.summary: 子曰：视其所以，观其所由，察其所安。人焉廋哉？人焉廋哉？ —— What he does, why he does it, whether he enjoys it. Today: leaving at six sharp the week the boss is away.

entry.title: 2.9 Hui is not slow
entry.summary: 子曰：吾与回言终日，不违如愚。退而省其私，亦足以发，回也不愚。 —— Whether someone has learned shows outside the classroom.

entry.title: 2.8 Zixia asks about filial piety (the hard part is the face)
entry.summary: 子夏问孝。子曰：色难。有事，弟子服其劳；有酒食，先生馔，曾是以为孝乎？ —— All the work was done; the face never arrived.

entry.title: 2.7 Ziyou asks about filial piety
entry.summary: 子游问孝。子曰：今之孝者，是谓能养。至于犬马，皆能有养；不敬，何以别乎？ —— Both readings land on reverence. Today: sending money on time, but sounding impatient on the phone.

entry.title: 2.6 Meng Wubo asks about filial piety
entry.summary: 孟武伯问孝。子曰：父母唯其疾之忧。 —— Three readings of one line, side by side. Today: staying up all night drinking, riding without a helmet.

entry.title: 2.5 Meng Yizi asks about filial piety
entry.summary: 孟懿子问孝。子曰：无违。樊迟御，子告之曰：孟孙问孝于我，我对曰无违。樊迟曰：何谓也？子曰：生，事之以礼；死，葬之以礼，祭之以礼。 —— Today: borrowing money to throw a lavish birthday banquet is “doing what one may not”.
